_comment: Host init/teardown CI golden (Blackhole, bh_p150_perf). REAL CI captures (min aggregate, ns) from bh_p150_perf silicon. NOTE: Blackhole single-chip teardown is ~0.6 ms, ~200x cheaper than Wormhole single-chip teardown (~115 ms) - Wormhole pays a fabric/dispatch teardown cost that a single Blackhole chip does not - so the Blackhole golden is intentionally very different from the Wormhole one. Still NOT gated: the runtime_perf_host_init_teardown CI job runs compare_host_init_teardown_ci.py with --ignore-times (structure only, no errored benchmarks). Arm the gate by dropping --ignore-times once tolerances are confirmed. Metric = host-side real_time (ns) of the min aggregate: BM_host_init = MeshDevice open, BM_host_teardown = MeshDevice close. bh_p150_perf is a single-chip SKU, so only single_chip runs here; mesh_2, mesh_4, ... light up on multi-device SKUs (see the wormhole golden).
